title: 56_the_truth_about_colt
episode: "56: The Truth About Colt, Part One

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who do you think is the most popular boy at Centerscore?
Do you think Sam and Colt should get back together?

labels: Throw the rag at his feet!
Throw the rag at his head!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm just surprised that Taylor moves so quickly.
Taylor puts a hand on Colt's chest and leans in.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're really hot too. You're so...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Manly?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Popular! Want to go out tonight?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you can't fool me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just didn't think it would get to me this much.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm proud of you. If this had been a year ago, you would've knocked over a table by now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE. But that doesn't make me feel any better about this Taylor thing.
The flame lights the salts but dies.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's wrong with it? What did you do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Me? I was just standing here. The better question is, how did you screw this up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't do anything. You probably just didn't add the right amount of methanol. Hand me that jar.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! I'll do it.
Sam and Colt fight for the jar of methanol...
It spins out of their grip and lands on another lit beaker! The entire beaker ignites!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sammy, duck!
Sam drops to the floor as a fireball flares from their lab table.
The fire alarm blares! The ceiling sprinklers go off!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, it's raining `inside!` And instead of class, we're going outside. No one told me it was opposites day!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hector, it's raining [i]inside![/i] And instead of class, we're going outside. No one told me it was opposites day!

nodes.text: The students and the entire school evacuate to the parking lot.
An hour later...
Sam and Colt wait outside Principal Shapiro's office.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm very sorry, $Scott. I heard about the sprinklers and just assumed it was you.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It wasn't even me the last time!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You're free to go back to class.
$Scott walks out of the office.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Next!
Sam and Colt walk in and sit across from Principal Shapiro.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Ah, Colt. My second guess.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And Sam? I'm surprised you're involved in this fiasco.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Caution must be taken when handling lab chemicals! To remind you of the importance of that, you both have detention for the entire afternoon.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?! But it was an accident.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And that excuses you from negligence how? Accident or not, you are both responsible.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just put it on my tab, Principal Shapiro. Just put it on my tab.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Both of you, report after school today. You're dismissed.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She must like me. I'm booked to see her after school every day until the end of the year.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What an achievement.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, Colt, you've done enough for one day. Just leave me alone.
Sam leaves.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, really, Sammy? You know more about chemicals than I do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm the guy that services my own bike and mixes my own gas to keep it running smoothly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Try doing that without knowing a thing or two about chemicals.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I buff my bike every day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That last part has nothing to do with chemistry.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's part of the process! And cleaning supplies are chemicals!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've made your point. Fine. Go light your matches.
Colt lights a match and drops it into a beaker.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do you even know why we're lighting things on fire?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For science?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Well, yeah, but do you even know what we have to do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You should know, I don't underachieve because I'm dumb, Sam. I underachieve because I can.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: School doesn't teach me anything I want to know.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you admit that you haven't read the lab and have no idea what we're doing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Fine. Light your dumb matches.
Sam lights a match and drops it into a beaker.
Sam looks around for another partner.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? You don't want to be my partner, four-eyes?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Please don't hurt me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know why everyone reacts that way.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Is there a problem, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, Mr. Russell. Just trying to find a partner.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Looks like Samantha is having the same problem. I'm sure you can use your immense brainpower to solve this dilemma...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't work with him!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Can't or won't? As both of you have sufficiently scared off the rest of the class, you're working `together.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Can't or won't? As both of you have sufficiently scared off the rest of the class, you're working [i]together.[/i]

nodes.text: At their lab table...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm with you. Can't you be nice to other people, so they can deal with you instead?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You do one hostile takeover of their black market Star Battles authentic items racket...  And suddenly the nerds stop wanting to work with you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And you're asking me to be nice? Wasn't that Angie I saw cowering in the corner?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever. We're stuck together for an hour. Let's just get the work done.
Sam and Colt stand behind a lab bench crowded with materials.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, all we need to do is stick the salts into beakers, light them on fire, and add a little methanol.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fire?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You write down the results, and I'll light the matches.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or `you` can write down the results, and `I'll` light the matches.
nodes.text_bbcode: Or [i]you[/i] can write down the results, and [i]I'll[/i] light the matches.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! There's absolutely no reason why I should trust you with fire.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What gives you the right to boss me around?

nodes.prompt: What gives you the right to boss me around?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What gives you the right to boss me around?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Angie.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hi, uh, Sam... Did you want anything?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Want to be lab partners?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Lab partners? With me? But you're a cheerleader. I'm a nerd. That would be like mixing water into a concentrated solution!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And don't you remember what happened last time?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't yell at you, did I?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Worse! You made me cry! You dumped my potion down the drain!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It had nothing to do with the lab!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That was the secret to creating life on other planets!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You might be right. You know what? I'm sorry. I'll just... Ask someone else.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That didn't go over well at all!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Amanda, want to be lab partners?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sam! I'd love to be your partner.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You always know what you're doing...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...But that would leave Hector all alone!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, well, I don't want to do that. You and Hector should definitely work together.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're so nice, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I needed to hear that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe that she's... Flirting!
Taylor puts a hand on Colt's chest and leans in.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're really hot too. You're so...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Manly?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Popular! Want to go out tonight?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you okay?
Sam slams her hand down onto the nearest table... Where the nerds were playing a board game!
The table flies up! Cards and food fly everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, that was a game we were playing!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Noooo! I just got the spawn points for my level 10 fire dragon!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I just rolled a 20 on my death blow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoops, sorry guys. Sam didn't mean it. She was just upset...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Upset? Upset?! I'll show you upset!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Upset is not being able to capitalize on the power play I used to manipulate Brendan into blocking his own power portal!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And do you know how much chance goes into rolling dice?!
And twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And the lesson we learned today is not to mess with nerds when they're rolling dice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: At least that lecture took my mind off the whole Taylor thing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really, I'm fine. Taylor can date whoever she wants.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... Whatever you say, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt and I are history. Taylor just surprised me. Trust me, she's free to have him.
That Friday at lunch...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So after Howard told them about their new baby sister, the twins just flipped out!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really? Kay and Kel going on a prank rampage is almost predictable by now, but...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I mean, Taylor. She's over there with Colt!
Two tables over, Taylor slides next to Colt and leans up against him.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey there, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hello, hot cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So you think I'm hot?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I wouldn't be talking to you otherwise.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Didn't you just say this wasn't going to bother you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not! But do they have to do it where everyone can see?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do what? Talk to each other?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes. No. I mean, look at her. She's hanging all over him!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to see Taylor make out with my ex!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you sound a little crazy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, Sam. Seeing Colt and Taylor hurts, but get yourself under control.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They suit each other `perfectly.`
nodes.text_bbcode: They suit each other [i]perfectly.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's a self-centered bad-boy jerk who breaks his promises and likes being mean to other people.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's a self-absorbed blonde.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're going to be the popular couple that gets axed first in the zombie movies.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're playing it awfully cool, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm totally over Colt, so it doesn't matter.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm so over him I don't remember that he's funny.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Or has an awesome motorcycle.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Or used to call me 'Sammy.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, I get the feeling you're not telling me the truth.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Exactly! Which brings me back to the real purpose of this meeting!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There was a point?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Colt is the hottest guy in school.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Which means we `must` date.
nodes.text_bbcode: Which means we [i]must[/i] date.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: All of us?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, I mean he and `I` must date.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I mean he and [i]I[/i] must date.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is what the annual rankings is about. My boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding. You can't date Colt.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I, er... He's...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's a rebel who hides his emotions.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're talking like I care about emotional availability in a boy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Besides, he's cute.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now that we cleared that up. Let's move on to the next order of business... Our new diet!
Later, after much debate over what not to eat...
Sam and $ZOE walk home.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe we talked about a diet for over an hour. The rainbow diet? Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're just mad because your favorite food is chocolate, and that's not a color of the rainbow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Sam? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, sure. I can survive boring girl talk.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I meant about Taylor and Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why should I care?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You just seemed really upset that Taylor was into Colt.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I was thinking, if you don't want Taylor to go after him, you should say something.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: First off, Taylor is not going to back down because I tell her to.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And second, I think Taylor dating Colt is a `great` idea.
nodes.text_bbcode: And second, I think Taylor dating Colt is a [i]great[/i] idea.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If it's a great idea, why are you so angry?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please, $ZOE. I'm not mad about Colt and Taylor. I think...

options.label: Taylor and Colt deserve each other.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have to say Colt.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Geez, don't be such a downer. Admit it, he's hot!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I totally agree. The muscles, the bad-boy attitude, the sunglasses. Even his motorcycle!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's there to not love about Colt?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: His rotten personality?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't think we take that into account when we rank boys.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Colt is amazing. And the most popular guy on campus!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is so uncomfortable.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Zach is, uh, good-looking. And a football player.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Clearly, you know nothing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do I have to remind you what the social hierarchy even means?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Zach used to be at the top, but he's been a broken wreck ever since Amanda dumped him!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Je m'appelle Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And, besides, what's there to not like about Colt?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: His rotten personality?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't think we take that into account when we rank boys.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Colt is amazing. And the most popular guy on campus!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is so uncomfortable.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I really hate these meetings.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Dude, at least you got onto a board!
Taylor moves to the next set of boards.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, Sam. Here's a hard one.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Taking in account all factors such as date-ability, physical attractiveness, coolness, and whatever.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who is more popular? Colt? Or Zach?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have thought about him a lot since that night in the park...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But why do we have to talk about him now?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Zach doesn't measure up to Colt at all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I don't want to say `Colt.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But I don't want to say [i]Colt.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, Sam? It's not like you're choosing between Dusklight's Edgar and Jake. Who's more popular?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Kenji, right?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector didn't win?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Rookie mistake, Sam. Kenji is dateable, but not popular. His bad-boy image was shaken when he got together with Linda.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But he's recovering from that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And he will eventually.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, `Hector`, is more popular.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now, [i]Hector[/i], is more popular.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But completely undateable.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hector, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He has an awesome party van and is friends with all the girls!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector won!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Very good. But unfortunately, Hector is happily dating Amanda. Combine that with the fact he's a male cheerleader, and you have a guy who is popular...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But completely undateable.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course we never rate students like Justin because aside from achievement, there is no anticipated social mobility.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is his achievement?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He noticed the difference between the twelve plus inch skirts and the seventeen plus inch skirts. Which, if you recall, was a major cheer decision.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's just sketchy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But moving on to more serious business...
Taylor puts up the next set of boards which has photos of Kenji and Hector.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, Sam, which one is more popular?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Are you serious?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you blind?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It sounded like a trick question!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course I don't think Justin is more popular.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Clearly, Howard is much hotter than Justin. That's why I used to have a crush on him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! That's my boyfriend you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was just stating a fact, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thankfully, that was just a test. Try to keep up, new girl.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that even a contest? Howard, of course!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's the football quarterback, has excellent hygiene, and is well-dressed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do you know he has excellent hygiene?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because I've heard you mention he has minty fresh breath when you make out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which I totally didn't need to know.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, anyway, that was just a test. Good job, new girl.

nodes.title: The Truth About Colt, Part One
nodes.subtitle: Help Sam sort out her feelings!

nodes.text: Welcome back to Centerscore High!
It's Thursday night, and Sam, $ZOE, and the other cheerleaders are waiting in Taylor's room for an urgent cheer practice!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We don't have to wear uniforms or put up our hair, and we're not warming up. What kind of squad meeting is this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor says it's 'the most important squad meeting' we'll ever attend. It sounds serious.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, right. The last time she said that, we debated cheerleader skirt lengths for an hour.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Twelve plus or seventeen plus inches? Remember?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee. I don't even remember what we decided.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Exactly. I can only imagine what this is about.
Taylor walks in, holding three black slabs of cardboard.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This, girls, is one of the most important squad meetings you'll ever attend. This is why you're here on a school night.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We are here to discuss... Boys!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not this again...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How is this different from lunch?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And how is that part of being a cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's not enough that we're attractive and train to look ultra good out on that field!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're also the top of the social ladder! And we know everything about what goes on in this school, and that includes `boys.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're also the top of the social ladder! And we know everything about what goes on in this school, and that includes [i]boys.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Which are the cutest, which are the funniest, and which we take advantage of because we can.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Can Hector and I leave now, or do we have to...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Quiet! As many of you know, many factors determine the coolness and date-ability of a boy. It's our job to rank every guy in the school based on their achievements, wardrobe, hygiene, and anticipated social mobility.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How are we scoring them?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Using the exact, objective rating of... Face Matching!
Taylor puts up one of the posters. A picture of Justin is pasted next to a picture of Howard.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Here is our first exhibit. Justin or Howard?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So, new girl, popularity quiz. Let's see how much you've picked up since you started.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uhm...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not you. `Other` new girl. Which of these two guys is more popular?
nodes.text_bbcode: Not you. [i]Other[/i] new girl. Which of these two guys is more popular?

nodes.text: Sam and $ZOE work their way towards Colt and Taylor's table, picking up dishes and putting them on trays.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think I even got a tip!
Sam and $ZOE get rid of their trays and duck behind a pillar.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Perfect! This is the best spot to hear them!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...I've had my leg broken before. The time I ran for Homecoming.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I ran once... From a bicycle gang for taking one of their motorcycles.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I love taking things from people!
Ten minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So because she upstaged me at the middle school pageant, I had to take this girl's sparkly hairband...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice use of petty larceny.
And twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then, one time, after I beat the crap out of this guy in Boot Camp, I had to clean the floor with my toothbrush...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, hygiene in a guy is so important to me!
$ZOE drags Sam back into the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Falling asleep. And learning way too much about Colt's shady dealings than I wanted.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At the rate this is going, Taylor's never going to leave him alone.
Sam walks out first... But suddenly slams right into another waitress and falls to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Ack!
The waitress's tray of food goes flying!
A plate of pasta lands on top of Sam's head!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Eww! Gross!
$ZOE pulls Sam back into the kitchen before the waitress can turn around.
Sam pulls steaming noodles from her hair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Were you pretending to be a waitress or a linebacker?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is so gross! Waitressing is harder than it looks!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks for saving me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. Too bad we can't hear what they're saying.
Sam sees Taylor and Colt laugh at an inside joke.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They look like they're enjoying the date.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What am I going to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay if you still have feelings for Colt. Sometimes, you can't help it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought you didn't like him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't. He's not very considerate, and he abandoned you in a park in the middle of the night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I care about you, and you still care about him. And I think you should sort things out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're right. I'm going to talk to Colt. And that means...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Crashing his date with Taylor!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Crashing his date with Taylor![/i]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not quite what I meant...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, cuz!
Sam runs out the door!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...I should've seen that coming. Sam, wait up!
In the kitchen of Le Restaurant Fancy...
$ZOE and Sam crouch down behind a counter of chefs preparing food.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This kitchen looks an awful lot like our cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Stay down, $ZOE. I don't want Taylor to see me. She will not be happy I'm here to ruin her date.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How are you going to talk to Colt then?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe if I can hear what they're saying, I can figure out a better way to get Colt alone.
$ZOE opens the kitchen door to look at the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But they're all the way across the room. How are we going to get there?
Sam sees waiters coming in and out of the kitchen through swinging doors. Sam picks up a tray.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Act like a waitress.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A goody-goody?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't get it, $ZOE. You don't even know how to get into trouble.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, how can you say that? Getting into trouble doesn't have anything to do with anything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I'm not you, but I definitely understand how you feel!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, are you crying?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniff... sniff... No!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to accuse of you of being a goody-goody. Well, I did, but I didn't think you would be so hurt about it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's fine. It's nothing. I just wanted to say that I understood.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard is the all-star quarterback with the winning personality. Colt is `not.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard is the all-star quarterback with the winning personality. Colt is [i]not.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam. Howard may not be Colt, and maybe I don't know why you like him so much, but I can understand how you feel.
$ZOE hugs Sam!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do you think I felt when Linda was in Howard's life, and he couldn't decide between us?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I had a good reason, Sammy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure, a good reason. Like he got on your nerves? Or you wanted a limo ride? Or maybe you just got bored?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really? That's what you think of me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I want to trust you, Colt, but...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You don't.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine. I see how it is. Don't let me ruin your life.
Principal Shapiro enters the room.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Good job, you two. This room looks great!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Sam, Colt, I hope this will remind you both to refrain from creating flash fireballs in the future.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, Principal Shapiro. I certainly learned `something` today.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, Principal Shapiro. I certainly learned [i]something[/i] today.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You can go home now.
Sam and Colt walk out of the music room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Listen, Colt... I...
Suddenly Colt spots Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Taylor!
Taylor runs up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, handsome. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I changed my mind about what you said earlier.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You mean about dinner at Le Restaurant Fancy?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure. It's on. Pick you up at eight?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tee hee. Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You really are a jerk.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Takes one to know one. See you around, Sammy.
After a long lecture from her mom, Sam flops on her bed. $ZOE enters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You look like you're in real need of ice cream therapy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I look that bad, huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did evacuate the entire school, serve detention, and get yelled at by your mom for being careless, so... Things don't sound like they're great.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I also screwed things up with Colt, and now he's on a date with Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Colt? Didn't you want him out of your life? Isn't that a good thing?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, you wouldn't understand...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No way! You're blaming me for this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're here because if you hadn't gotten so uptight about being right, one of us would've been looking after our lab stuff.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not talking about detention. Maybe chemistry lab wasn't `all` your fault.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not talking about detention. Maybe chemistry lab wasn't [i]all[/i] your fault.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But what about the night you stole Tom Prince's limo?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A terrible team?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hah, well, yeah maybe a terrible chemistry team.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But we're here because you need to be right all the time.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And the reason you broke up with me is because you think you know exactly what happened on the night I stole Tom Prince's limo.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you admit it?
Sam and Colt happily toss rags at each other, until dust flies everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You throw like a girl!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha! Stop, stop! We're making this worse!
Colt nails Sam in the head!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt! You're making this worse!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So it might have gone too far...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Straighten up, Colt. Shapiro'll be back soon, and the instruments are all out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See, detention's not all bad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's more fun than I thought.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I forgot how much I loved hanging out with Colt. But I don't want to like him again!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's what I do. Bring the fun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Would you like to keep flirting with yourself, or can we actually put the instruments away before Shapiro keeps us here longer?
An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, why do they have to store the clarinets on the top shelf? Almost... Got this...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Here. Let me.
Colt takes the instrument from Sam and puts it on the top shelf.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My hero.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So we're even.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Even?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For that expulsion thing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You got me in major trouble. How is getting something from a tall shelf going to make us even?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You stuck your neck out for me, and I stuck mine out for you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was your arm.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Neck, arm. Same thing. It's just my job to take care of you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Didn't you get fired from that job?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Being fired hasn't stopped me yet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha. Cute.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes, I am.
Sam stares up at Colt.
Colt puts a hand in her hair.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You have a piece of fluff there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You going to make a move or what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I still like you, but I can't do this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why not?

options.label: I get into trouble around you.

nodes.text: Sam catches the dust rag, just as Colt raises his own. Sam and Colt stare at one another.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Truce?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Truce.
Sam and Colt start to lower their rags...
Then raise them and throw them!
Sam ducks under the rag.
Colt stands with another dust rag, poised to toss it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, don't you dare...
Sam throws the rag and nails Colt's feet.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ooh, dust on my shoe? That right arm out of practice?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I'm a little rusty.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, try this!
Colt throws another rag at Sam!
Sam pelts Colt right in the head with a rag!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ahh!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's lots more where that came from.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Try this!
Colt throws another rag at Sam!

options.label: Throw the rag at his feet!
Throw the rag at his head!

nodes.text: Sam ducks, picking up her own dust rag.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha! Take this!
Sam gets clocked with the dust rag. Dust flies everywhere!
Sam picks up a dust rag.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey! Take this!
After school that day...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Your detention is to be spent cleaning the music room. This room should be sparkling by the time I come back in a couple hours.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sam, I leave you in Colt's hands. He's been doing this so long, he's an expert. He'll show you what to do.
Principal Shapiro leaves.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You hear that? Who's the better student now, Sammy?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Being an expert at detention doesn't make you the better student. Now are you going to tell me what I'm supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's not rocket science. Wipe everything down. Put instruments away.
Colt and Sam get to cleaning.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: At least cleaning the music room is better than writing lines.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, you can only write 'I will not throw spitballs at the teacher's head' so many times before you get mad, throw spitballs, and have to do it all over again.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Cleaning the music room is somewhere above running laps in the rain but definitely below highway clean-up. At least then you get fresh air.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't have a rating. I've never had detention before now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh really? Didn't you get expelled from your last school?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. Because I stayed out past curfew waiting for you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Oh. That sucks. Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not as sorry as I am, being covered in all this dust.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right there, Princess. Can't roll up your sleeves and do real work? Did Monarch Prep soften you up that much?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha! Yeah right. I just have better things to do with my Friday night.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then you won't mind if I do this?
Colt throws a dust rag at Sam's head.
In fact, you were so close to getting that shiny, bonus scene!
Play again to get that perfect score!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about Taylor? And your date?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Taylor... Will be just fine. Right now, I owe you a ride home.
Wow, Sam may not know how things will turn out with Colt, but at least she's got the chance to try!
And all because you played a great game!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I, uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm here because of you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I admit it, I followed you here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I never figured you for the stalking type, Sammy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was jealous. Am jealous.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wanted to talk to you. About us.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There's an 'us' now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I want there to be.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't get you, Sammy. You ditch me in the park because you don't want me in your life...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And you blame me for everything bad that happened in the past.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And now you're crashing my date with a cheerleader to say you want there to be an `us?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And now you're crashing my date with a cheerleader to say you want there to be an [i]us?![/i]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What I said in the park was that you're important to me. And the truth is, you still are.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Even after I broke up with you, I wasn't sure how I felt. And then, when Taylor started flirting with you... I knew that I still liked you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What happened in the music room made me realize how much I miss you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So what do you want me to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, I know what I said before, and there are still some things I want to know.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I want to hear your side of the story.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe this is a bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe we really are terrible together...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I still care about you. I can't help it. And I want to try to make it work again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, what do you say?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This probably is a bad idea...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...But I never let that stop me before.
Colt leans down to kiss Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Still good?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Still good.
Just then a waitress comes into the kitchen... The doors swing open, and Colt spots Sam!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh no! He's coming straight towards the kitchen!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's what you wanted, right? I'll wait outside.
$ZOE darts out the door as Colt pushes the swinging door hard and storms in.
Sam tries unsuccessfully to hide behind a tall pot.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sam? Why are you here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I work here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha ha. Last time I checked, water is safer being thrown out than boiled by you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you really doing here? Food at home not up to boarding school standards?

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What can we do from the kitchen? Wait, their food!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you can't sabotage their food!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, I know you're really `nice,` but I have to do this. I can't let Taylor and Colt happen! Not before I get the chance to talk to him!
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, I know you're really [i]nice,[/i] but I have to do this. I can't let Taylor and Colt happen! Not before I get the chance to talk to him!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now I know Taylor hates peanuts because she never touches them whenever we eat...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, are you sure you want to do this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if something bad happens?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It'll be fine. Look, I just need to talk to Colt alone for one minute...
Sam pours peanut sauce onto Taylor's food right before a waitress whisks it away.
Sam and $ZOE watch from the kitchen window.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: I present to you... Your dinner.
Taylor takes a bite...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, cough... Cough. What is this? It tastes like... Peanuts!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Taylor? What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Cough... Cough... I'm deathly allergic!
Taylor faints in the middle of the restaurant!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Call an ambulance!
A few days later...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Order, order! Cheer-trial now comes to order! Samantha, you are accused of poisoning our head cheerleader Taylor for personal gain.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Witnesses put you in the kitchen of Le Restaurant Fancy on the night in question, also known as Friday night.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Poisoning is punishable by instant disqualification from the squad, the return of your pom-poms, and your demotion to 'regular, high-school girl'!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What do you have to say in your defense?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I admit it. I did it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I had no idea she was allergic!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know she especially avoids peanuts!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor avoids most foods!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Silence!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Try telling that to Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because of you, she might never fit into the size 2 uniform that inspires us to eat less every day!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam, I told you not to mess with her.
Wow, Sam's on trial for poisoining Taylor?!
And she never even got to talk to Colt!
Try again and see if you can get a better ending for Sam!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have to go after them!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, wait!
Colt and Taylor turn around.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I need to tell you something. I'm still in love with you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sam...
Sam kisses Colt!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just what do you think you're doing kissing `my` man?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just what do you think you're doing kissing [i]my[/i] man?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Your` man?
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Your[/i] man?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sammy. But there's something you should know... I'm in love with Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It was a surprise for both of us. I always knew she was hot!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I knew he was appointed the hottest guy on campus by the totally objective and fair Face Matching ranking.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I thought I only liked Taylor as a cute cheerleader, but it turns out...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: With her ruthlessness and ability to manipulate people through hotness...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She's the perfect accomplice!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't understand. You're not a saint, Colt, but you're definitely not into major crime!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Yet.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We'll start small. A betting racket on the tennis team here, a den for counterfeit hall passes there.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As long as she keeps getting clothes, we're in this relationship for the long haul.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So that means you need to back off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, Taylor! You're going to have to make me.
Sam lunges at Taylor, knocking her to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Everyone knows you go after a girl's `hair` first! Say good-bye to those highlights!
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone knows you go after a girl's [i]hair[/i] first! Say good-bye to those highlights!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're totally off the cheer-leading squad!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, ladies! I'd tell you not to fight over me, but... I'm not going to stop this.
Wow, Taylor and Sam fighting? The only person enjoying this ending is Colt!

nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just wish I could forget all about Colt.

nodes.text: It was a surprise for both of us. I always knew she was hot!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I knew he was appointed the hottest guy on campus by the totally objective and fair Face Matching ranking.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I thought I only liked Taylor as a cute cheerleader, but it turns out...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: With her ruthlessness and ability to manipulate people through hotness...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She's the perfect accomplice!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't understand. You're not a saint, Colt, but you're definitely not into major crime!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Yet.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We'll start small. A betting racket on the tennis team here, a den for counterfeit hall passes there.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As long as she keeps getting clothes, we're in this relationship for the long haul.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So that means you need to back off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, Taylor! You're going to have to make me.
Sam lunges at Taylor, knocking her to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Everyone knows you go after a girl's `hair` first! Say good-bye to those highlights!
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone knows you go after a girl's [i]hair[/i] first! Say good-bye to those highlights!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're totally off the cheer-leading squad!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, ladies! I'd tell you not to fight over me, but... I'm not going to stop this.
Wow, Taylor and Sam fighting? The only person enjoying this ending is Colt!
Try again and see if you can make some better choices and get that great ending for Sam!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

In fact, you were perfect!
Here's your bonus scene!
Outside Le Restaurant Fancy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE?! Are you here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here!
$ZOE runs up to Howard's car.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What were you doing in there?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hiding from Sam and Colt.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They were here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They left. Thanks for picking me up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why didn't they take you with them?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They were... Wrapped up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Will Sam be okay with Colt?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope so.
Later, at Taylor's house...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Emergency meeting of the cheerleading squad!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This, girls, is one of the most important squad meetings you'll ever attend!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This will be entirely about boys!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Aw, man!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why do we get called into these meetings?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Didn't we do this last week?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why is she so angry?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Quiet from the front row! We have the new hottest guy to pick.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But I thought Colt was...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Colt` decided to ditch our date.
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Colt[/i] decided to ditch our date.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Colt is nothing to me.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But what about Sam? Shouldn't she be here for this?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As far as I'm concerned, Sam has a lot to answer for...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Since it was `Sam` I saw riding on the back of Colt's motorcycle...
nodes.text_bbcode: Since it was [i]Sam[/i] I saw riding on the back of Colt's motorcycle...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gulp! I hope Sam knows what she got herself into.
Yikes! Look like Taylor `won't` be just fine.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yikes! Look like Taylor [b]won't[/b] be just fine.

nodes.text: And that's your perfect ending!
See you next time in Part Two!
